en.title: Elegy of Star-Iron and the Shore of Forgotten Names
en.premise: Seris, a village once erased from the map by a divine blunder. The only beacon keeping its memory alive is Astraea's Eye, an ancient lighthouse that has burned for a millennium. Guided by a forbidden tome, a young archivist named Elysion sets sail for the distant seas to silence the 'Song of Despair' echoing from the survivors of the lost village. There, he will confront a cruel truth, scrubbed away from the pages of history.

zh.title: 星铁的挽歌与失名的汀
zh.premise: “塞里斯”是一个曾因神的失策而从地图上被抹去的村庄。唯一能将这段记忆维系至今的指路明灯，是燃烧了千年的古老灯塔——“阿斯特赖亚之眼”。年轻的记录官埃律西昂遵循禁书的指引，为了终止失踪村庄的幸存者所发出的“绝望之歌”，踏上了前往绝海的旅程。在那里，他将面对被涂抹在历史背面的残酷真相。
